title: Cosmic Battle on Clouds
description: A dynamic fantasy battle scene unfolds on a wooden platform amid stormy clouds. Multiple fantasy characters including a lion warrior, a female archer, a blue armored figure, a hooded spellcaster, and a large ethereal female spirit with swirling energy are engaged in combat with magical effects, lightning, and flying debris under a dramatic swirling sky.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy battle scene set on a wooden platform floating among stormy clouds, featuring a muscular lion warrior in red cape and armor charging forward, a female archer with red hair leaping with a glowing green bow, a blue armored superhero running with energy blasts, a hooded spellcaster summoning wind and books, and a giant translucent female spirit with long flowing hair and multiple arms manipulating swirling green magic orbs and wheels, all surrounded by lightning, floating debris, and a massive purple and teal cosmic vortex in the turbulent sky.
